commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=ca165a9d57fcde4da19b2a649cb1792ffe961405
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
cd frontend
npm ci
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
test -f dist/index.html
cd ..
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=ca165a9d57fcde4da19b2a649cb1792ffe961405
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
sudo -n true
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo 'production checkout dirty; refusing deploy'
  git status --short --branch
  exit 20
fi
git fetch origin main
git checkout main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
mkdir -p .dev
SNAP=.dev/app.db.pre-original-migration-ca165a9.sqlite
if [ ! -e "$SNAP" ]; then cp -a backend/data/app.db "$SNAP"; fi
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('backend/data/app.db')
try:
    result = conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    print('sqlite_integrity_before=' + str(result))
    if result != 'ok':
        raise SystemExit(21)
finally:
    conn.close()
PY
make schema-check
make migrate-photo-originals ARGS="--output-json .dev/photo-original-preflight-ca165a9.json"
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('.dev/photo-original-preflight-ca165a9.json')
r = json.loads(p.read_text())
s = r['summary']
print('preflight_summary=' + json.dumps(s, sort_keys=True))
if s['issues']['by_severity']['error'] != 0:
    raise SystemExit(22)
if s['candidates'] + s['already_migrated'] != s['approved_photos']:
    raise SystemExit(23)
if s['approved_photos'] == 0:
    raise SystemExit(24)
PY
echo '=== DISK BEFORE ==='
du -sb backend/storage
df -B1 / | tail -n1
echo 'production_head='$(git rev-parse HEAD)
REMOTE
STAGE=.dev/frontend-dist-ca165a9
tar -C frontend/dist -cf - . | ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 "cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && rm -rf '$STAGE' && mkdir -p '$STAGE' && tar -C '$STAGE' -xf - && test -f '$STAGE/index.html'"
echo preflight_and_frontend_stage_ready
